why: GUARD: the ONLY Vercel project for this repo is 'web' (root directory: web/).
A duplicate project ('claude-orchestrator') was once auto-created by importing the
repo ROOT. vercel.json's git.deploymentEnabled:false disables git deployments for any
project ever pointed at the repo root again, so a duplicate can exist but can never
silently build or deploy. Do not re-enable it.
This note used to live in vercel.json as a `_comment` key, alongside a
`_deploymentDisabledIntentionally: true` flag. vercel.json is schema-validated and
rejects unknown top-level keys, so both made `vercel deploy` fail from the repo root
Error: Invalid vercel.json - should NOT have additional property `_comment`.
They live here instead. runner/vercel_config_guard.py reads this file to know the
no-deploy state is deliberate, which is what stops its `deployment_disabled_everywhere`
advisory re-filing itself as a backlog task on every sweep.
